name: com.quickcoderhub/pdf-suite
description: 20 PDF MCP tools: repair, audit, merge, split, rotate, watermark, redact, forms, compress.

tools.name: pdf_repair
tools.description: Scan damaged PDF binary objects and reconstruct broken/truncated XRef tables and trailers via pdf-lib. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/repair-pdf/

tools.name: pdf_compliance_audit
tools.description: Audit a PDF for hidden 3-Tr invisible text operators, OCG layers, active /JS, annotations, and metadata leaks, and optionally issue a SHA-256 Compliance Certificate PDF. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/pdf-compliance-audit/

outputPath.description: Optional local output path for SHA-256 Compliance Certificate PDF.

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Merge multiple base64-encoded PDF documents cleanly in exact page order via pdf-lib. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/merge-pdf/

base64Data.description: Primary PDF base64 (used if documentsBase64 omitted).

documentsBase64.description: Array of base64 PDFs to concatenate.

tools.name: pdf_split
tools.description: Split a PDF by page range or page chunk size into an extracted PDF slice plus per-range metadata. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/split-pdf/

tools.name: pdf_remove_pages
tools.description: Delete specified 1-based page numbers or ranges from a PDF document. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/remove-pdf-pages/

tools.name: pdf_extract_pages
tools.description: Extract and reorder specific 1-based pages from a PDF into a new PDF file. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/extract-pdf-pages/

tools.name: pdf_rotate
tools.description: Permanently rotate all or selected pages of a PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees clockwise. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/rotate-pdf/

pages.description: Optional 1-based page filter (defaults to all pages).

tools.name: pdf_add_page_numbers
tools.description: Stamp vector pagination or Bates numbers (e.g. "Page X of Y") onto every PDF page. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/add-page-numbers/

tools.name: pdf_add_watermark
tools.description: Overlay a diagonal translucent vector text watermark (e.g. CONFIDENTIAL) across all pages of a PDF. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/add-watermark/

tools.name: pdf_crop_margins
tools.description: Trim uniform PDF CropBox margins (in points) across all pages while preserving vector content. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/crop-pdf/

tools.name: pdf_protect_metadata
tools.description: Audit PDF encryption state, scrub identifying Creator/Producer/Author metadata, and stamp deterministic integrity protection headers. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/protect-pdf/

tools.name: pdf_unlock_strip_restrictions
tools.description: Load owner-restricted PDFs (ignoreEncryption) and re-serialize clean unlocked pages without permission locks. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/unlock-pdf/

tools.name: pdf_redact_terms
tools.description: Scan PDF text streams for target terms or PII patterns (emails, SSNs, cards) and purge matching raw stream literals + metadata before re-saving. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/redact-pdf/

tools.name: pdf_forms_inspect_and_fill
tools.description: Inspect all interactive AcroForm fields in a PDF, optionally fill text/checkbox fields from JSON, and flatten form widgets. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/pdf-forms/

fieldValues.description: Map of fieldName -> string value to fill.

tools.name: pdf_to_markdown
tools.description: Extract uncompressed PDF text operators (Tj/TJ) and document metadata into clean Markdown. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/pdf-to-markdown/

tools.name: pdf_to_pdfa_archival
tools.description: Normalize a PDF for long-term ISO-19005 PDF/A-like archival consistency by flattening forms, embedding standard fonts, and setting XMP/catalog timestamps. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/pdf-to-pdfa/

tools.name: pdf_compare
tools.description: Structurally compare two PDFs (page count, page dimensions, metadata, SHA-256, and extracted text tokens) to pinpoint differences. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/compare-pdf/

secondBase64Data.description: Second PDF base64 (defaults to self-comparison if omitted).

tools.name: pdf_compress
tools.description: Compact a PDF structurally by stripping unused objects, clearing XMP/metadata bloat, and enabling PDF 1.5 compressed Object Streams. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/compress-pdf/

tools.name: pdf_from_images
tools.description: Wrap one or more JPEG/PNG images (or fall back to an annotated vector page) into a clean PDF document. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/jpg-to-pdf/

tools.name: pdf_from_html_text
tools.description: Render HTML or plain text into a paginated vector PDF document using pdf-lib. Interactive 100% browser-local UI: https://quickcoderhub.com/html-to-pdf/

text.description: HTML markup or plain text to render to PDF.
